implementation.record_format: [-999,unit,case,length,actual...] and separate expected with identical metadata
implementation.ram_file_workspace: One SDK FIL, 4136 bytes in NOLOAD .tdc_ut_boot_workspace at0x200000a8 after unchanged RTT control. Explicitly zeroed before every fixture; no normal object. Host uses a separate static mock FIL. Four former automatic SDK FIL frames exceeded4KB; current selected ARM maximum frame1184, total call-chain/IRQ depth unverified.
implementation.lifetime: run_unit returns BUSY until release. Caller drains common RTT reporter before release.
implementation.file_fixture_policy: Host supplemental tests create only temporary, rooted files. Target subcases use RAM-only file callbacks, run real ci_boot.c, and inspect the resulting 64-byte RAM record. Logical 4096-byte preallocation is modeled without a real allocation. No target NVM writes, erase, image DMA, RF or reset is automatically run.
implementation.hardware_boundary: Host uses SDK register/memory constants and product data structures. File/NVM/DMA/CRC/GPIO/timer/reset boundaries are modeled. Product AES, CRC word/remainder loop, header/manifest/section logic, service RTT parser and slot state machine run unchanged.
implementation.host_byte_count_abi: Mock FatFs UINT is host size_t to preserve full counts for product size_t out parameters on 64-bit Windows. ARM checks use actual SDK UINT/ABI.
implementation.target_read_fixture: Subcases 101+ explicitly replace file/read or NVM read interfaces with RAM callbacks. 8 covers boot-info read/CRC, not manufacturing calibration. 10 covers normal/encrypted header parsing; 11 covers boot-data section parsing and two-core boot flags without image DMA; 12 calls manifest opening through RAM file/directory boundaries and zero-section apps. 19/20 run real slot-file/state logic against RAM, not physical filesystem/NVM.
implementation.target_crc_fixture: 13 uses public key and actual SDK hardware CRC. Caller must own foreground CRC engine; runner restores CFG/VALUE and previous key/read override.
implementation.target_cleanup: Runner exchanges all 1020 scratch words before/after execution, including unsupported return. File/read/NVM/key/slot context is restored by each fixture. RAM-only host QA seeds nonzero callbacks, scratch pattern, CRC registers, slot/private FIL, boot error and core boot-data/flags, then checks unchanged values after each execution and after BUSY/release/repeat.
implementation.ram_diagnostic_boundary: During an explicit RAM read override only, process_manifest skips existing diagnostics which directly read SYSVAR_MANU_TABLE. With no override and in normal builds the original diagnostics run. File logic/expected return values are unchanged.
implementation.target_observer: Explicit observer can copy transfer type/address/word mode/count, PRAM lock, boot LED elapsed/phase/duty, service LED color and reset request. IRQ callback must only copy RAM; observations alone are not PASS.

verification.evidence_contents: UTC times, invocation, all BOOT source/header/linker/project and fixture/criteria SHA256 values, commands/return codes/stdout/stderr, O0/O2 per-case actual/expected/status, known failures, oracle guards, ARM stack frames. Error traceback and incomplete command/run remain saved if compilation, execution or comparison fails. --output selects a separate history path.
verification.arm_units: 8 source files compiled with/without TDC_UNIT_TEST. Normal runner object has no global test symbols. Runner -fstack-usage maximum frame1184 bytes, unchanged4136-byte FIL section and5176-byte BSS are checked. No link/RTT address relocation occurs here; sections.ld is unchanged.
verification.exit_meaning: Regression checker accepts exactly six failing records (BOOT7 C6/C17; BOOT11 C6/C108/C109/C110). Exit0 is exact reproduction, not product PASS. Missing/changed known failures, duplicate cases and unpaired/truncated logs are rejected. Python -O is rejected because it disables checker assertions.
verification.immutability_checked: Run while pending returns -3 and both full arrays/count stay unchanged. All zero-default hooks restored in full host run. RAM-only QA checks nonzero previous contexts/state, repeat stability, no fixture files and no NVM/reinit/GPIO/config/timer/trim/delay/file/image DMA/core/reset boundary calls. Service restores static counters and detects unclosed files; delay restores the injected clock.

known_product_failures.finding: bootloader_load_manu_table returns CRC error, but storage initialization ignores the return and proceeds to mount/success.
crc_table_size=1 with zero actual section headers returns success. Read status/count/completeness are not validated after the loop.
Same missing-declared-section defect as host C6, independently exercised by RAM-only target-compatible fixture with two declared sections and empty input.

Boot-info read succeeds; manufacturing NVMReadBytes fails with -9. The caller ignores the loader error, returns0 and publishes output. The requested preparation/error contract requires failure propagation and no success output publication.
known_product_failures.handling_needed: Check manufacturing loader return before UART/mount/output publication; preserve a failure result for the caller. Product fix requires separate authority.

known_product_failures.finding: Two sections declared; first header read returns FR_DISK_ERR with zero bytes. Read result is ignored and no-section success0 is returned.
known_product_failures.handling_needed: Reject failed header reads and incomplete declared sections before exposing load flags. CRC alone does not establish input completeness.

known_product_failures.finding: After valid CFX boot data, the next header read returns FR_DISK_ERR with zero bytes while the CM3 section remains declared. Function returns CFX-loaded flag1 instead of error. The RAM fixture never transfers an image or starts a core.
known_product_failures.handling_needed: Separate partial-load observations from the final success decision and propagate later read failures. Policy for discarding already parsed boot data remains a product decision.

coverage.target_not_implemented: Actual Sys_Delay waits on hardware. A target argument-only trace requires an explicit tdc_util.c delay boundary outside this worker scope. No fabricated timing or surrogate arithmetic test is reported as real delay execution.
